note: Every part has UV0 and no embedded images. map = sRGB colour; normalMap and aoMap are data maps (aoMap on UV0). tint: skin, hair, robe, headwear and sash are multiplied in the browser; null = none.

body.note: head, neck, hands, wrist stubs, ankles and feet; UV0 is shared by the mirrored halves, so the maps are symmetrical

eyes.note: both eyeballs (front domes with a cornea bulge); glossy, never tinted; rigid to the head bone

brows.note: alpha = texture alpha x COLOR_0 alpha; the texture repeats (wrap = repeat)

hair.note: alpha = texture alpha x COLOR_0 alpha (edges dissolve); wrap = repeat

beard.note: alpha = texture alpha x COLOR_0 alpha (edges dissolve); wrap = repeat; optional part

garment.robe.note: COLOR_0 carries soft fold shading (light greys)

garment.headwear.note: dome cap and two ribbons of wound cloth; ribbons are single sheets

garment.sash.note: waist band and two hanging ends
